mechanics.requiredMatches: Both complete silhouettes and both visible roof-owner landmarks.
mechanics.submissionBudget: Four incorrect submissions lose; a correct final-chance submission wins.
mechanics.undo: Restore the entire previous pair of physical positions without refunding failures.
mechanics.clock: Admitted public calls and actual accepted dt; no timer loss or pressure-game ticks.

testNames: public API and exact immutable configuration match the accepted three-task tables
creation normalizes identity and allocates detached round data without consuming seed randomness
synthetic public-anchor fixtures freshly project and pass all four checks for every task
synthetic legal extrema remain in twenty cells with negative camera offsets and correct width
near and far ordinary moves have distinct two-cell and one-cell projection displacement
synthetic equal-height far roof loses ownership and its designated anchor is hidden
the published main-view false placement is rejected by a fresh two-view submission
submission ignores forged cached match flags and recomputes actual geometry
view emphasis and focus selection preserve both projections, placements and undo history
whole-pair undo restores edits across both layers without refunding rejection or view/focus
history discards only the oldest full pair at the thirty-two entry cap
history, caches, receipts and fresh positions do not alias each other
movement bounds consume the edge without history, move count or repeated hold effects
direction threshold, clamping and vertical diagonal ties use one deterministic edge
simultaneous B A and direction consume all edges with B then A priority
four distinct incorrect submission edges lose once and held A never repeats
a correct last-chance synthetic placement wins after three actual rejected submissions
a correct arrangement stays active until A and receipts preserve exact updated call and clock
start and retry quarantine held controls until a genuinely neutral admitted sample
epoch changes and persistent cancellation suppress stale input and cannot synthesize a release
first epoch is a baseline, invalid epochs are ignored, and cancellation rises disarm
only own literal data values are accepted and ordinary accessors never run
malformed containers and nonnumeric axes become empty or neutral without coercion
throwing or revoked proxy normalization discards all partial fields before paused handling
invalid durations, literal paused calls and terminal calls are exact no-ops
one admitted large call means one edge and exact bounded active-clock addition
synthetic counter and clock caps signal only overflow and never settle play
fresh retry restores all dirty fields and identical sequences remain deterministic

four actual rejected submissions produce the natural loss
no page, console or resource errors
